projects.title: Healthcare Patient Analytics
projects.summary: An end-to-end analysis of synthetic hospital patient records using MySQL, Python, Power BI and Excel, finished with two dashboards and a written report.
projects.problem: Hospital administrators need a clear view of admissions, conditions, billing and test results to plan care and capacity.
projects.public_note: The data is a synthetic Kaggle healthcare dataset, so the findings are illustrative. The project is also documented as a TikTok series for beginners.
features: MySQL cleaning: removed 2 duplicate rows, standardised text, converted dates and engineered 6 new columns
Python (pandas) validation with IQR outlier checks and exploratory analysis
Power BI dashboard with DAX measures, a date table, five slicers and KPI cards
Matching Excel dashboard built from pivot tables and slicers
A written report with key findings and recommendations

images.alt: Screenshot of the Healthcare Patient Analytics dashboard in Power BI with KPI cards, slicers, admissions trend, blood type, test results and age group charts
Screenshot of the matching Healthcare Patient Analytics dashboard built in Excel with slicers, KPI cells and pivot charts

projects.title: Lung Cancer Analysis Dashboard

projects.problem: Understand how lung cancer patients are spread by country, cancer stage, smoking status and treatment, and how survival relates to them.
projects.public_note: The dashboard uses a cleaned subset of 130,819 patient records taken from a source file of 890,000 rows.
projects.publish_block_reason: Confirm the dataset source and licence before publishing.
features: KPI cards for total patients, average age and average treatment duration
Overview page with patients by gender, cancer stage and year
Survival by smoking status, and by treatment type and family history
Country Details page with a map of patients by country and a patient table
Filters for smoking status, asthma, hypertension, gender, survival and BMI range

images.alt: Screenshot of the Lung Cancer Analysis Dashboard in Power BI showing KPI cards, gender, smoking status, cancer stage, treatment type and yearly charts with filters
Screenshot of the Country Details page of the lung cancer dashboard with a map of patients by country and a patient table
